sourceCaveats: All four current official sample styles and the current TABOR notice acquired as complete original PDFs. Their union contains four local questions: three attached here and county lodging1B now prepared once for its exact eligible territory in lodging-voting-areas.

The Cortez sample1 omits county lodging1B while the other samples include it. Current2026 C.R.S.§30-11-107.5(3) expressly excludes municipalities with their own lodging tax from the county lodging-tax election. The separate lodging-voting-areas packet supplies exact county-minus-Cortez geometry; countywide voter attachment is not used.

The term-limit question was transcribed from visible sample1 page2 because the embedded OCR interleaves columns. All three financial questions use the clean native-text TABOR source; arguments are excluded from bounded excerpts.
limits: Current official four-style Montezuma sample union and TABOR notice only; not statewide local completeness.
